title: Highland Cow Christmas Clipart, 12 Cute Highland Cow PNG and SVG with Holly, Wreath, Scarf and Winter Hat, Sublimation Designs for Tees
description:
Twelve cozy highland cow Christmas clipart designs: shaggy ginger cows and calves with holly, a pine wreath, a striped scarf, a knitted bobble hat, fairy lights, a bauble, mistletoe and a gift. Each one comes as a full-color PNG with a transparent background at 300 dpi, plus a one-color SVG line-art version of the same design.

Use them for Christmas tees and sweatshirts, sublimation mugs and tumblers, tote bags, cards, gift tags, stickers, invitations and holiday crafts. The cows are drawn in a warm flat style with clean dark outlines, so they stay crisp on light and dark backgrounds.

THE 12 DESIGNS
1 Holly crown · 2 Cozy scarf · 3 Pine wreath · 4 Bobble hat · 5 Winter stroll · 6 Sleepy calf · 7 Tree carrier · 8 Fairy lights · 9 Bauble horn · 10 Wreath collar · 11 Mistletoe · 12 Gift box

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 12 PNG files, transparent background, 300 dpi, 3600 px on the longest side (12 in), ready for sublimation, print and print-then-cut
• 12 SVG files: the same designs as single-layer, one-color line art that scales to any size
• One ZIP download with a README and the license

GOOD TO KNOW
• The SVGs are line-art versions for one-color printing, recoloring and crafts, not vinyl cut files: some fur lines are fine
• There is no text on the designs
• The tee, card and tote in the photos show the designs in use; you receive the digital files only
• Colors vary a little between screens, printers and blanks

LICENSE
Personal use, plus small-business use on physical items you make and sell (tees, mugs, tumblers, totes, cards, stickers), up to 500 items per design. Please don't resell, share or upload the digital files, use them on print-on-demand marketplaces, or include them in other digital products.

THIS IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
No physical item will be shipped. The files are available right after purchase in a single ZIP from Duskwood Designs Co.

Designed with the help of digital and AI tools, and checked by hand.
